note: The maintainer asked for this release after friends' feedback, knowing the packaged-window, clean-install and live-provider journeys below were not walked on this build. Missing journeys are recorded as not_observed; release_readiness.py is expected to refuse complete stable-readiness certification.

fresh_install.evidence: Installer not run: this machine has Kriko installed and the installer's hook would stop it and rewrite its registration. The installer was extracted with 7-Zip instead: it holds the app, the engine and OpenSERP and no catalogs.

portable_start.evidence: Portable archive built and hashed; the extracted portable window was not walked.

setup.evidence: Not walked on the packaged window.

compare.evidence: Automated coverage passed; packaged Compare was not walked live.

reconnect.evidence: Not walked on the packaged window.

sourced_answer.evidence: No live research was run against the 0.3.3 frozen engine; the new local-agent hosted search and the Kriko Agent continuation are covered by automated tests only.

follow_up.evidence: Follow-up routing (an answer to the agent's own question keeps the web route) is covered by automated tests only.

observed_instead: Frozen 0.3.3 engine passed the standard smoke: health, settings, empty store, lookup, failing-job, MCP and terminal checks.
Native release app stayed up for 25 seconds, did not panic and spawned its bundled engine.

In the web interface's demo mode (dev server): the chip explanation line, the folded run timeline and the wider thread column were observed in Chrome. Product cards and follow-up suggestions did not appear in demo mode, so the folding product list was not seen on screen.
Extracted installer: its engine started in 2.4 seconds on a throwaway profile and answered /api/health.
Installer, portable, engine and extension artifact SHA-256 checks passed.
